# MessagePack

`msgpack.min.js` is the unmodified UMD browser distribution of `@msgpack/msgpack` 3.1.3, from https://registry.npmjs.org/@msgpack/msgpack/-/msgpack-3.1.3.tgz.

Source: https://github.com/msgpack/msgpack-javascript

License: ISC; see `msgpack.LICENSE`. Served locally, without a runtime CDN dependency. The upstream source map is not shipped.
